The remit

Four connected capabilities.

A website alone cannot fix slow follow-up. An automation alone cannot repair a confusing customer journey. New software creates little value if the team does not know how to use it.

Dakyworld works across the connected areas that make a digital system useful: the customer-facing platform, the movement of information, the removal of repeated work and the people who use the process every day.

01

Websites & web platforms

Turn your digital presence into a working business tool.

We design and improve websites, landing pages, e-commerce experiences, customer portals and internal web tools around a clear business outcome: credibility, enquiries, sales, bookings, customer self-service or smoother operations.

Typical work includes:

  • Corporate websites and website redesigns
  • Landing pages and campaign pages
  • E-commerce and product journeys
  • Customer portals and internal web tools
  • Conversion-focused content structure and calls to action
  • Forms, analytics and lead-capture setup
  • Website performance and usability improvements

Best for: Businesses with an outdated website, weak enquiry flow, unclear offer, poor mobile experience or a need for a more useful customer platform.

02

Automation & AI

Give repeated work a better process.

We identify tasks that take time every week, then design practical automations and AI-assisted workflows around the way your team already works. The goal is useful progress, not more software for its own sake.

Typical work includes:

  • Lead capture, routing and follow-up workflows
  • Content planning, drafting and publishing processes
  • Client onboarding and internal handoff workflows
  • Scheduled reports and operational notifications
  • AI assistants for defined internal tasks
  • Workflow mapping and automation opportunity reviews
  • Automation optimisation after launch

Best for: Teams spending too much time copying information, chasing follow-ups, preparing repetitive reports or coordinating routine work manually.

03

Integrations & business systems

Make important tools work together.

Disconnected tools create duplicate work, missed context and delayed responses. We connect the systems that support your customer journey and internal operations so information reaches the right place with fewer manual steps.

Typical work includes:

  • CRM setup and lead-pipeline refinement
  • Website, form and WhatsApp connections
  • Payment, booking and calendar integrations
  • Email sequences and customer notifications
  • Dashboard and reporting connections
  • Process mapping and system recommendations
  • Data flow and handoff improvements

Best for: Businesses whose website, inbox, CRM, spreadsheets, calendar and customer conversations do not currently operate as one connected process.

04

Training & consulting

Make sure people can use what you build.

New systems only create value when people understand them. We help teams adopt the website, workflow, automation and AI tools they need through practical training and decision-focused guidance.

Typical work includes:

  • AI adoption workshops
  • Team onboarding for newly implemented workflows
  • Website, CRM and process training
  • Workflow and digital-systems reviews
  • Technology and automation planning sessions
  • Leadership advisory for prioritising digital investments

Best for: Teams adopting new tools, leaders deciding what to improve next or organisations that want practical AI and automation guidance without unnecessary complexity.

One connected system

Build it. Connect it. Improve it. Teach the team.

A typical engagement may start with a clearer website and lead-capture flow. We then connect enquiries to a CRM or WhatsApp process, automate the follow-up and train the team to use the system confidently.

You can engage Dakyworld for one defined service. When several needs are connected, we create one roadmap so the work is sequenced sensibly rather than delivered as unrelated tasks.

The boundary

Said plainly, so nobody is surprised later.

Clear about what we do.

Dakyworld is a remote digital systems and automation partner serving businesses across Ghana and West Africa. We work through structured communication, calls and screen sharing.

We do not repair laptops or printers, install office networks, provide physical-device support, run managed cybersecurity operations, administer everyday business email or cloud infrastructure, or offer general on-site IT support.

Where a specialist service is required, we will say so clearly.
